+import pytest
+
+from jsonschema import Draft201909Validator, Draft202012Validator
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator", [Draft201909Validator, Draft202012Validator])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "subschema, instance, keywords, paths",
+    [
+        (
+            {"type": "string", "minLength": 3},
+            {"a": 1, "b": "x", "c": "good"},
+            ["type", "minLength"],
+            [["a"], ["b"]],
+        ),
+        (
+            {"allOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"enum": ["ok"]}]},
+            {"bad": 1, "good": "ok"},
+            ["type", "enum"],
+            [["bad"], ["bad"]],
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_property_context(Validator, subschema, instance, keywords, paths):
+    schema = {
+        "properties": {
+            "payload": {"unevaluatedProperties": subschema},
+        },
+    }
+    errors = list(Validator(schema).iter_errors({"payload": instance}))
+    assert len(errors) == 1
+    error = errors[0]
+    assert error.validator == "unevaluatedProperties"
+    assert [child.validator for child in error.context] == keywords
+    assert [list(child.path) for child in error.context] == paths
+    assert [list(child.absolute_path) for child in error.context] == [
+        ["payload", *path] for path in paths
+    ]
+    assert all(child.parent is error for child in error.context)
+    assert all(child.instance == instance[path[0]] for child, path in zip(
+        error.context, paths,
+    ))
